description: This PHP source file defines the QuickSearchDefaults class, which provides default configurations and methods for setting up quicksearch components in the SuiteCRM project. The class includes methods for generating quicksearch query configurations for various modules (Accounts, Contacts, Users, Campaigns), as well as methods for loading related quicksearch configurations and including necessary scripts.

classes.name: QuickSearchDefaults
classes.description: Class providing default quicksearch configurations and helper methods for different modules in SuiteCRM. It supports customization, module-specific search configuration generation, and inclusion of necessary JS scripts.

methods.name: getQuickSearchDefaults
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and return a QuickSearchDefaults object, optionally using custom class overrides.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name used by quicksearch components.

methods.name: getQSParent
methods.description: Returns the quicksearch configuration array for the Accounts module as default parent module.

methods.name: getQSAccount
methods.description: Returns the quicksearch configuration array for the Accounts module with customizable address fields.

methods.name: getQSContact
methods.description: Returns the quicksearch configuration array for the Contacts module, supporting name formatting and locale considerations.

methods.name: getQSUser
methods.description: Returns quicksearch configuration for the Users module for selecting assigned users.

methods.name: getQSCampaigns
methods.description: Returns quicksearch configuration for the Campaigns module.

methods.name: loadQSObject
methods.description: Loads quicksearch configurations based on module, object, and relationship, supporting custom method overrides.

methods.name: getQSScripts
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags required for quicksearch functionality, including loading the quicksearch.js script.

methods.name: getQSScriptsNoServer
methods.description: Returns quicksearch scripts with no server dependencies, same as getQSScripts.

methods.name: getQSScriptsJSONAlreadyDefined
methods.description: Returns quicksearch scripts with JSON pre-defined, suitable for contexts where scripts are already included.
